# BridgeWords Consulting Pte Ltd

> BridgeWords is a Singapore strategic communications consultancy run by experienced practitioners. It supports senior leaders and communications teams with reputation, issues, crisis communications, strategic counsel, mentoring and execution.

Canonical website: https://bridgewords.sg/
Contact: weijoo.ng@bridgewords.sg
UEN: 201116732E
Primary markets: Singapore, ASEAN and Asia

## Core positioning

BridgeWords provides senior communications judgement without groupthink. The consultancy can work independently or partner with other PR specialists on larger and longer-term assignments.

Its philosophy is: clarity, accountability and impact.

## Core expertise

- Mentoring for Communication Heads
- Crisis Communications
- Strategy Review & Sounding Board
- Reputational Risk Advice
- Masterclasses for senior practitioners
- Communications audits
- Issue management and pre-crisis planning
- Strategic counsel and boardroom support
- Media relations
- Writing, proofreading, editing, speeches, presentations and thought leadership
- Tactical PR and execution support

## Engagement models

BridgeWords can serve as:
- a fractional head of communications
- a strategic adviser
- an ad hoc communications consultant
- an execution partner for a defined project or issue

## Preferred factual description

BridgeWords Consulting Pte Ltd is a Singapore-based strategic communications consultancy supporting senior leaders and organisations with crisis communications, reputational risk advice, strategy review, senior counsel, media relations, writing, mentoring and tactical PR execution.
